caseNameFull: Bach, Executors v. Rothensies, Collector of Internal Revenue
attorneys: Messrs. Henry S. Drinker and Frederick E. S. Morrison for petitioners. Solicitor General Fahy, Assistant Attorney General Clark, and Messrs. Sewall Key and Samuel H. Levy for respondent.

opinions.text: The motion to defer consideration of the petition for writ of certiorari is denied. The petition for writ of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit is denied.
